builds.name: Devilish Chipper
builds.desc:
Abusing the power of Windsweep and a Guard with no HP threshold in favor of a second hit via Firesweep, this build prioritizes landing true free damage on opponents for allies to move in for the kill.
Incinerator109

builds.name: Forbidden Offense
builds.desc:
With an offensive line Love Abounds Lyn can only dream of, this build takes full advantage of Land's Bounty Niles' offensive capabilities. With a Slaying Bow, Niles can prioritize using the Special cooldown and Desperation to increase his damage output; meanwhile, Firesweep Bow prioritizes safe hits and using his great natural B skill, Atk/Spd Link, to full effect. Between Attack and Speed natures, Niles will prefer +Attack; given how great his Speed is, especially with a Speed reforge and Atk/Spd Link active, adding on three extra damage per hit tends to be more productive against most opponents.
Incinerator109
